response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), r AS (SELECT account_id, region, n, n - (SELECT AVG(n) FROM oc) AS diff FROM oc), t AS (SELECT account_id, region, n, diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM r) SELECT account_id, region AS A3, n AS order_count, diff AS diff_from_avg FROM t WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC
